What changed in this PR This PR aligns poteto-mode’s GitHub watcher and merge gate so unfamiliar bot-review formats do not block readiness without supported counted-section evidence of findings lacking review threads. **Changes:** - Apply the same finding-evidence rules to all bots while preserving acknowledgment, pending-bot, and unresolved-thread gates. - Remove unread-review blockers and notes, and expose `findings` directly in watcher output. - Update playbooks, promise checks, and regression coverage, including a clean Copilot review without a Findings line. | File | Description | | Review effort: Balanced

### 🔵 Needs a closer look The reader counts summary markup inside code literals as active findings, causing clean bot reviews to block the watcher with exit 8. **No open issues** 🎉
1 previously missed issue In code that hasn't changed since last review
Ignore counted summaries inside Markdown code literals `skills/​poteto-mode/​scripts/​watch-pr/​review-bodies.ts:163` `countedSections` scans raw Markdown, so a clean bot review containing `Open (1)` inside fenced or inline code produces an `(unparsed)` finding. Applying this reader to every bot now makes such previously unrecognized non-Copilot reviews block the watcher with exit 8. Ignore counted summaries inside code literals and add regression cases for both fenced and inline examples.
Review effort: Balanced
